title: AutoPRL: Automated Path Representation Learning via a Learnable View Generator
abstract: arXiv:2610.35032v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Self-supervised learning has emerged as a powerful paradigm for Path Representation Learning (PRL) in road networks. PRL aims to learn informative representations of paths traversed by moving objects, such as vehicles, where each path consists of a sequence of connected road segments. These representations are essential for various downstream tasks, including travel-time estimation and path ranking. However, existing methods often suffer from ineffective view generation and inefficient training procedures due to their reliance on heuristic augmentations and computationally intensive contrastive learning. To address these issues, we propose AutoPRL, an effective and efficient self-supervised PRL framework that integrates three key components. The Automatic Data Augmentation (AutoDA) module employs variational autoencoders to generate semantically meaningful and diverse feature-level path views by modeling each topology-aware node embedd

translated_title: AutoPRL：通过可学习视图生成器实现自动化路径表示学习
translated_abstract: 自监督学习已成为道路网络中路径表示学习的一种强大范式。PRL旨在学习移动物体（如车辆）所经过路径的信息丰富表示，其中每条路径由一系列相连的道路路段组成。这些表示对于多种下游任务至关重要，包括行程时间估计和路径排序。然而，现有方法由于依赖启发式数据增强和计算密集型的对比学习，常常存在视图生成效果不佳和训练过程低效的问题。为解决这些问题，我们提出了AutoPRL，一个有效且高效的自监督PRL框架，它集成了三个关键组件。其中自动数据增强模块采用变分自编码器，通过对每个拓扑感知的节点嵌入进行建模，来生成语义上丰富且多样化的特征级路径视图。
tldr: 提出了自监督路径表示学习框架AutoPRL，通过基于变分自编码器的可学习视图生成器自动生成语义丰富的路径视图，替代传统启发式增强和低效对比学习，实现了更有效且高效的路径表示学习。
en_tdlr: AutoPRL is a self-supervised path representation learning framework that uses a learnable view generator based on variational autoencoders to automatically create semantically meaningful path views, replacing heuristic augmentations and inefficient contrastive learning for more effective and efficient representation learning.
